title: USDA FSIS: How do I reheat leftover take out food?
text: Reheat previously cooked foods or leftovers to an internal temperature of at least 165 °F ( 73.8°C). Always use a food thermometer to verify the internal temperature of the food. Reheat sauces, soups, and gravies to a boil. If reheating in the oven, set oven temperature no lower than 325 °F (162.7°C). Reheating in slow cookers and chafing dishes is NOT recommended because foods may stay un the Danger Zone (between 40 °F and 140 °F )(4.44 °C and 60°C) too long. When reheating food in the microwave oven, cover and rotate food for even heating. Always allow standing time before checking the internal temperature of the food in several places.
